parole.significato: A strict Anabaptist sect living mainly in Pennsylvania, Ohio, and Indiana.
parole.testo: From Pennsylvania German Amisch or German Amische, after the name of the Swiss preacher Jakob Amman (1645-1730). The surname is a contraction of Old High German ambahtman.

parole.significato: To cast a spell on (specifically an evil spell), to bewitch.
parole.testo: First attested about 1830, from Pennsylvania German hexe (“to practice witchcraft”), from German hexen (compare Hexe (“witch”)). The noun appeared later, in the 1850s.
